title: Timeline
description: Event timeline. Each event carries both absolute in-world time and narrative (chapter) time.

chapter.description: Chapter id where this event occurs, e.g. v01-c003.

absolute_time.description: In-world time label, e.g. 'Year 3 of the Republic, spring' or 'Day 7, dusk'. Free-form.

narrative_time.description: Position in the story's pacing, e.g. 'vol1 midpoint' or 'post-inciting-incident'. Free-form.

participants.description: Character ids involved in this event.
